transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I... I don't really know where to start. It's just... at home. In my little studio. Nobody else is there, it's completely quiet, but... I keep hearing voices. 

Just as clear as somebody standing right in the room with me. They just... they keep saying my name. Telling me my work is being judged. So... that's why I came in, I guess.
About how long have you been hearing these voices?
Um... a while. I guess... maybe about nine months now. That's when the voices started. And... just knowing that people are watching my work. It's been about nine months.
During these past nine months, have you been experiencing persistent feelings of depression or sadness?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really felt sad. Just... dealing with what I told you.
Have you been using any recreational drugs, or substances like cannabis, around the time these experiences began?
No... I don't use anything like that. Just... no.
Do you have any medical conditions or physical health problems?
No. I don't have any health problems. I'm fine physically. Just... what I said before.
